sources.title: Continuing to bring you our latest models, with an improved Gemini 2.5 Flash and Flash-Lite release
sources.evidence: The September 25, 2025 launch announces the exact gemini-2.5-flash-lite-preview-09-2025 identifier for testing that day in AI Studio and Vertex AI. It reports improved instruction following, concision, audio transcription, image understanding and translation, and explicitly separates this preview from the stable model. Reopened October 27, 2026: the update describes training goals and fewer output tokens, not a smaller parameter count; it gives no total or active model size.

sources.title: Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite preview — Gemini API
sources.evidence: The exact version page documents 1,048,576 input tokens, 65,536 output tokens, text/image/video/audio/PDF inputs, text output, thinking and function calling. Its current notice states that this model shut down March 31, 2026; these are last-documented capabilities, not evidence of an operating endpoint.

sources.title: Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite Model Card — September 26, 2025
sources.evidence: Reopened the complete September 26, 2025 card on October 27, 2026. Page 1 explicitly covers Preview (09-2025), describes sparse MoE transformers and token-dependent expert selection, and pages 4 and 7 distinguish the September preview from June variants. No nominal total or active parameter count appears in its architecture, training or comparison sections.

sources.title: Gemini API Additional Terms of Service
sources.evidence: The current service terms govern AI Studio and Gemini API access and prohibit extraction or replication of the underlying models, including parameter weights. Together with the exact API-only release channels, they support a proprietary service classification, not an open-weight license. The current terms are effective March 23, 2026.

sources.title: Gemini deprecations — Gemini API
sources.evidence: The exact preview row gives September 25, 2025 release and March 31, 2026 shutdown. The separate stable gemini-2.5-flash-lite row gives July 22, 2025; these dates concern different versions.

sources.title: Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite Model Card — March 2026
sources.evidence: Rechecked the complete later card on October 27, 2026. Its comparison includes Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite Dynamic, with price, output speed and benchmark rows, but no total/activated-parameter row or exact September-preview identification. The stated Gemini 3 Pro base relationship concerns 3.1 Flash-Lite, not this older model.

sources.title: Gemini 2.5: Pushing the Frontier with Advanced Reasoning, Multimodality, Long Context, and Next Generation Agentic Capabilities
sources.evidence: Reopened the complete report on October 27, 2026. Section 2.1 describes sparse MoE routing without sizes; section 2.2 describes teacher-distribution distillation into smaller Flash-and-below models, which does not establish a count-preserving relationship to Pro. The Flash-Lite subsection explicitly identifies the June 06-17 preview, without numerical size. Neither the original June model nor the September update has a count-bearing named base in these documents.

sources.title: Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite Model Card
sources.evidence: Checked the later July 2026 card and complete comparison table. Its named base is 3.1 Flash-Lite, and its columns report price, benchmark and safety results, with no total or activated parameter count for Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite or the September preview.

sources.title: Gemini 3.8 Flash Model Card
sources.evidence: Checked the later model architecture and comparisons for a retrospective disclosure. They describe 3.7 Flash lineage and performance, without a total/active size for this September 2025 Flash-Lite record.

sources.title: Gemini 4 Argon Model Card
sources.evidence: Checked the October 2026 first-party architecture and comparison tables. Argon is explicitly not a fine-tune or modification of a previous model; no total/active-parameter column or numerical specification for Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite is supplied.

sources.title: Gemini 4 Argon Safety and Security Report
sources.evidence: Searched the complete freshly retrieved report for parameter counts and Flash-Lite comparisons. Its Flash-Lite monitoring experiments concern 3.5 Flash-Lite; parameter references concern generic model security, knowledge or experimental settings. No numerical total or active count for the September 2025 Flash-Lite preview was found.

sources.title: Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite Preview 09 2025 — SuperBased Tokenomics
sources.evidence: Fresh exact-version search surfaced a 1B total-parameter claim. Opened the live page on October 27, 2026: it provides no developer source for that number. Its provenance section concerns bootstrapped prices, not parameters; its disclaimer describes aggregated third-party specifications. This is an uncorroborated discovery lead, not accepted parameter evidence.

name.note: Preserves the exact September preview; the card writes the date suffix in parentheses.

developer.note: Released by Google DeepMind; Google is the catalog developer.

family.note: Normalized family key for the explicitly named Gemini Flash-Lite line.

release_date.note: The dated announcement makes this exact preview publicly testable that day. June preview, July stable release, and September 26 card publication are separate events.

open_weights.note: Released as a Google-hosted API model under service terms; no downloadable weights are distributed in the reviewed release materials.

license.note: Descriptive classification of the hosted model and API terms. Documentation copyright licenses are not model-weight licenses.

parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 exact-version and later-disclosure searches, reopened September release/card, Gemini 2.5 report and subsequent Google comparisons establish no published nominal total. SuperBased lists 1B without a developer citation and is not adopted. The updated-version relationship supplies no count because the earlier Flash-Lite size is also undisclosed; this result does not depend on requiring an exact tensor census.

active_parameters_b.note: Rechecked independently of total parameters. The exact September card explains sparse expert routing without an activated count, expert dimensions or routing fraction; later first-party tables give performance, price and safety rather than activated parameters. Thinking budgets, fewer generated tokens and teacher distillation provide no numerical per-token active count.

architecture.note: The September 26 card explicitly covers Preview (09-2025) and states sparse mixture-of-experts Transformer architecture. This is direct model-card evidence, not an assumption from another sibling.

context_window.note: Exact-version input-token limit; output limit is separately documented as 65,536.

modalities.note: Exact-version supported-data-types row, retaining the catalog ordering and PDF convention.

reasoning.note: Thinking is supported; the card evaluates the September preview both with and without thinking.

tool_call.note: Exact-version capability table explicitly supports function calling.

description.value: September 2025 preview of Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite with multimodal input, optional thinking and function calling.

summary: Fresh October 27 parameter re-audit reopened the exact September preview release, API specifications and updated model card, reviewed the Gemini 2.5 technical report, and checked later Google comparisons through Gemini 4 Argon. Total and active counts remain undisclosed. Investigated the exact-model SuperBased 1B claim, which has no developer provenance, and did not promote it to a verified count. Explicit null patches retain both unknowns; all other field assessments are preserved.
